summary: Shulker boxes and other blocks in the end exit portal when it changes state are not dropped as items
description:
## The bug

1.21 pre-release 1 finally fixed 
 
 
 
 MC-902
 
 Resolved
 
 by making the replaced blocks drop as items rather than outright deleted as previously. However, this behaviour does not apply to blocks placed within or around the exit end portal when the dragon is killed or resummoned.

The other kind of end portal is also affected, which is reported under 
 
 
 
 MC-227097
 
 Resolved
 
.

## How to reproduce

 - Enter the End

 - Place your precious shulker boxes inside the end fountain

 - Kill the dragon

## Expected results

As the end portal activates, the blocks replaced by the end portal would be dropped as items and would be sent through the portal.

## Actual results

Your items are now gone forever. Well done!

## Further notes

Also happens when the portal deactivates during the summoning ritual.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter the End.
2. Place shulker boxes inside the end fountain.
3. Kill the dragon.
4. Observe that when the exit portal activates, the shulker boxes are not dropped as items and disappear.
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

When the End exit portal is activated after the ender dragon is defeated, blocks located within or around the exit portal are replaced without dropping their corresponding items. This includes shulker boxes and other blocks, including blocks with stored contents. No item entities are created or sent through the portal, so the blocks—and any contents in them—are permanently lost.

The same occurs in reverse when the exit portal is deactivated during the ender dragon summoning ritual: blocks replaced by the restored fountain structure are removed without dropping as items.
Expected Behavior: When the End exit portal activates or deactivates, any blocks placed within or around the portal that are replaced by the portal structure should be dropped as their corresponding items rather than deleted. These item drops should remain recoverable and be sent through the portal, preserving shulker boxes and other affected blocks instead of permanently losing them.
